newsitem.title: EGYPT: KING HUSSEIN ARRIVES IN ASWAN.
newsitem.headline: KING HUSSEIN ARRIVES IN ASWAN.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein arrived in the southern resort town of Aswan in Egypt on Wednesday for talks with Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak on the latest developments in the Middle East peace process.
Airport sources reported the king's arrival, after which he and Mubarak toured the town.

The one-day talks are intended to discuss stepping up Jordan's role in the peace process, and are part of regular coordination to review peace moves and obstacles to moving ahead in implementing accords, Jordanian and Egyptian officials said.
"They will discuss ways of breaking the deadlock in peace talks in addition to bilateral ties," a Jordanian official said.
Jordan is worried that lack of progress in implementing Israeli-Palestinian peace accords could endanger regional stability.
It has recently stepped up criticism of Israel, accusing it of endangering the kingdom's security by reactivating plans for expanding Jewish settlements in the West Bank.
